responsibility: Implements deferred construction of diagnostic paths. The lazy_path methods in this file forward all path queries to an inner diagnostics::paths::path that is created only on first use by make_inner_path, allowing expensive analyzer-style path construction to be skipped entirely for diagnostics that are suppressed, while preserving the normal path interface once emission actually requires it.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the lazy-paths pair: it defines lazy_path's forwarding methods, the on-demand inner-path creation logic, and selftests, whereas lazy-paths.h only declares the lazy_path subclass interface.
